properties.title: Amid escalation, US allies hang back on intervening in Iran war
properties.summary: Many of America’s allies around the world are growing more comfortable waiting out the Iran war, even as the Trump administration argues their help is needed to end a conflict that’s rapidly spiraling out of control. properties.summary: Water levels across several of Europe’s major waterways have dropped to exceptionally low levels, setting new records in some areas. Extreme heat exacerbated by the climate crisis is intensifying the drought hitting the continent as record-breaking heatwaves means the hot atmosphere is evaporating water from rivers, lakes, soils and plants quickly. properties.title: Crete wildfire kills two firefighters as fierce flames spread in Greece
properties.summary: Wildfires continue to burn across Crete, Greece, where two firefighters died as strong winds fuelled the blaze and aircraft joined rescue efforts.

properties.summary: BRUSSELS — The EU on Thursday fired the starting gun on plans to fund seven multi-billion-euro computing hubs to train artificial intelligence models in Europe. The launch of an official process for seven industry consortia willing to build AI “gigafactories” fulfills a promise made by European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen at an AI summit last year to help Europe catch up in the race on AI. properties.summary: Active fires in Antalya's Kaş district and Muğla province forced evacuations and highway closures as extreme heat fanned blazes across six provinces.

properties.title: Watch out Brussels and Kyiv, Poland’s conservatives are veering right

properties.title: Body found in suitcase in Athens is that of 38-year-old British woman
properties.summary: Greek authorities identify remains as those of Elizabeth Jane Ross after discovery in a derelict building 11 days ago A body found in a suitcase in an abandoned building in central Athens has been identified as that of a 38-year-old British woman. Eleven days after the find, and following an appeal to foreign law enforcement agencies, Greek police shed some light on the mystery of the body that until Wednesday had remained unidentified. properties.title: Iraq eyes supplying Turkey with 1 million oil barrels a day amid Hormuz crisis
properties.summary: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Zeydi visited Ankara for his first talks with Erdoğan since taking office, offering to supply Turkey with 1 million barrels of oil per day as Ankara seeks to reduce its dependence on disrupted Gulf routes.
